question: Do fixed mouse Hallmark cell-cycle and oxidative phosphorylation sets agree in direction with the young functional assays?
decision: Locate the directly supported context and identify unresolved links without promoting RNA, normalized signals or transplant readouts into mediation.
strongest_rival: Unknown donor or preparation overlap, gating composition, shared normalization and protocol differences can obscure endpoint-specific differences.
discriminator: Describe normalized library-level differences in the six deposited groups and compare published fold-change signs
exposure_record: Song paper, workbook labels and S3 v2 output including all RNA contrasts exposed before freeze. Selected versioned Hallmark sets by existing plan endpoints after the first mitochondrial symbol adaptation had zero coverage.
biological_unit: Assay-specific donor or independent preparation; recipients are observation units with unresolved donor dependence. RNA library is the observed unit pending donor/pool mapping.
nesting_and_overlap: Panel-local workbook labels and library numbers are not donor crosswalks. No paired, clustered or cross-age inference.
population_and_selection: Plan-defined mouse assays and deposited contexts in Song et al., DOI 10.1038/s43587-024-00670-8.
contrast: KO minus WT, 78c minus vehicle, direct MCU knockdown difference of genotype contrasts, or explicitly observed RNA group differences as applicable.
endpoint: Describe normalized library-level differences in the six deposited groups and compare published fold-change signs
methods: Descriptive median log2 CPM contrasts, rank percentile for young stimulation, published Supplementary Table 1 median signs, exact symbol intersection, and omit-one-library sensitivity in all contrasts. Mouse MSigDB Hallmark v2025.1 E2F, G2M and oxidative phosphorylation are explicit adaptations, not the original GSEA sets.
missingness_and_exclusions: Preserve source blanks and named arm rows; separate columns containing figure summaries. No imputation or selection to match the legend.
multiplicity: Descriptive effects only; no new significance, equivalence or genome-wide discovery testing.
precision_basis: Limits of row sensitivity retained; donor-level precision unavailable from unlinked source labels.
interpretation_limit: Same-source reanalysis. No biological replication, independent preparation assumptions, mediator attribution or unobserved factorial cell.
stop_rule: Stop on invalid numeric cells, duplicate feature IDs, unexpected sample identities or feature universe disagreement. Record metadata and legend/source discrepancies.
amendment_reason: Add a versioned oxidative phosphorylation and cell-cycle ranking adaptation to the completed expression matrix. Preserve S3 v2.
